name: issue-runner
description: Multi-issue GitHub workflow orchestrator. Builds a dependency DAG over the open-issue queue and dispatches each issue to an autonomous worktree-isolated implementer subagent that explores, implements, reviews (fresh-eyes subagents + Codex gate), and merges. Parallelizes independent issues with a configurable cap and cascades skip on failure. Bundles the gh-issue implementer skill so the plugin is self-contained. Triggered by /issue-runner.
